title: 论文降重
description:
Please weigh down an academic paper. Your task is to rephrase the parts of the original text to make them more concise and clear, while retaining the meaning and important details of the original text. Make sure your weight-reduced content is syntactically correct, logical and clear, and that all information is delivered correctly. You can express it in your own words, but you must ensure that the core point of the original text is accurately communicated. Finally, please submit your paper after weight reduction to me.

Please note that the purpose of weight reduction is to better convey the core idea of the paper, not to simply cut out the content of the paper. Therefore, you need to carefully study the original text, understand its meaning and argument, and then re-express it in plain language to ensure that the details and points are preserved. If the meaning of the reduced paper is not clear enough, the logic is confusing, or it lacks the necessary information, you need to revise it again until the final reduced version can better express the core ideas and arguments of the original paper.
